# CoCheck

> CoCheck records what AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) change in a person's files and shows every change on a local review page, before and after, with the agent action that made it. It runs on the person's own machine and sends nothing anywhere by default. It is a preview release: macOS, or Windows with Claude Code as a test build; Node 22.18 or newer.

Install on a Mac with `brew install cocheck-ai/tap/cocheck` or on a Mac or Windows with `npm install -g cocheck`, then run `cocheck install --home ~/CoCheckData` from the folder CoCheck should watch. `--home` is required, has no default, and must be an absolute path. Ask the person before installing. Where this file and docs/install.md disagree, docs/install.md wins.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cocheck-ai/cocheck/main/AGENTS.md): what CoCheck is, how it works, its state, and how to install and use it for a person
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cocheck-ai/cocheck/main/README.md): overview, the author's notes and known limits, install and use
- [Install guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cocheck-ai/cocheck/main/docs/install.md): install, start and stop tracking, the review page, uninstall, troubleshooting
- [Connector guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cocheck-ai/cocheck/main/public-kit/GUIDE.md): build a connector so CoCheck can read another file type or app
- [Connector standard v1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cocheck-ai/cocheck/main/public-kit/spec/v1.md): the connector specification
